correctness_confidence.basis: All four main theorems (2.1, 3.2, 4.1, 5.1) and Lemma 3.1 check out from first principles, including the nome tau=R^-4, Schwarz-Pick factorizations, q_c=2 critical asymptotics, and double-layer Schur trace bound. Minor numerical drift in Table 2 (q=1.70..1.85) and a parenthetical typo on p. 5 do not affect the theorems.

rigor.basis: Proofs of Theorems 2.1, 3.2, 4.1(a)-(c), and 5.1 are self-contained and complete, carefully handling C^{1,1} parallel-body regularity for degenerate W(A) and Cl_2 equality rigidity. However, Theorem 4.1(d) relies on numerical observation of unimodality for R* ~ 2.041101, and Table 2 uses float64 optimization on an exponentially flat peak.

novelty.basis: Introduces normalized Schatten-q Crouzeix constants and establishes substantial original results: Cl_2 rigidity for the odd-even parity staircase, universal Ky Fan dominance on M_2(C), the unexpected Hilbert-Schmidt phase transition at q_c=2 refuting J_2 extremality for q<2, and the Schur completing-the-square trace trick beating 1+sqrt(2).

significance.basis: Completely solves the 2x2 Schatten-q Crouzeix problem across all q in [1, infty] and establishes dimension-independent universal bounds strictly below 1+sqrt(2) for all finite q, opening a structured research program via Conjecture 6.1, though the n>=3 global constants (such as Psi_2 = sqrt(2)) remain open.

reproducibility.basis: Provides exact closed-form formulas, explicit Lean 4.36.0 theorem identifiers, numerical benchmarks, and SHA-256 digests. However, Lean certification covers only the denominator-cleared algebraic/polynomial core rather than analytic conformal/POVM arguments, and high-q Table 2 maximizers require arbitrary-precision arithmetic.

summary: This paper introduces normalized Schatten-q Crouzeix constants Psi_q(A) and establishes four interlocking results. First (Theorem 2.1), universal singular-value weak majorization sigma(A) <_w s^(n) w(A) yields an exact odd-even parity staircase, Cl_2 rigidity of even-dimensional extremizers for q in (1, infty), and extension to centered disk polynomials via Berger unitary 2-dilation. Second (Theorem 3.2), the odd Riemann conformal map phi_R: E_R^o -> D simultaneously maximizes all unitarily invariant norms on M_2(C), giving Psi_q(A_R) = (theta_2(R^-4)/theta_3(R^-4)) * ((R^q+R^-q)/2)^(1/q). Third (Theorem 4.1), M_2(C) exhibits a sharp phase transition at q_c=2: J_2 is uniquely extremal for q>=2 (via theta_2(tau)^2/theta_3(tau)^2 < 4*sqrt(tau)/(1+tau)), whereas for every 1<=q<2 an interior ellipse beats J_2 with R*(q) ~ 4^(1/(4-2q)) and Psi_1(2) ~ 1.11557524. Fourth (Theorem 5.1), a self-contained double-layer POVM identity on C^{1,1} parallel bodies absorbs the Cauchy-transform cross-term via Schur triangularization and completing the square, giving ||p(A)||_{2,norm}^2 <= 4||p||_{W(A)}^2 + (1/n) sum |p(lambda_j)|^2 <= 5||p||_{W(A)}^2 and beating 1+sqrt(2) for all n>=1 and finite q. The theorems are valid; minor revision is recommended to fix a p. 5 typo and float64 precision drift in Table 2.
strengths: Theorem 2.1 cleanly unites weak majorization, the exact odd-even parity staircase, Cl_2 rigidity of even-dimensional extremizers, and Berger 2-dilation with Blaschke approximation for centered disk polynomials.

Theorem 3.2 proves universal Ky Fan dominance of the Riemann map phi_R on M_2(C) via an elementary two-regime Schwarz-Pick reduction and exact quadratic factorizations, yielding the exact Jacobi theta formula with nome tau = R^-4.

Theorem 4.1 uncovers and rigorously proves a striking Hilbert-Schmidt phase transition at q_c=2, combining a remarkably concise 6-line Jacobi-product proof for q>=2 with exact asymptotic scaling R*(q) ~ 4^(1/(4-2q)) and exponentially flat excess for q < 2.

Theorem 5.1 introduces an elegant, self-contained n-independent proof that Psi_2 <= sqrt(5) < 1+sqrt(2) without any upper bound on the Cauchy transform g_epsilon, using C^{1,1} parallel bodies and completing the square in an aligned Schur basis.
weaknesses: The n>=3 universal Schatten-q Crouzeix constants remain open between Psi_q(2) and Theorem 5.1 bounds (e.g., sqrt(2) vs sqrt(5) at q=2).
In Theorem 4.1(d) and Table 2, unimodality of R -> Psi_q(A_R) for 1<=q<2 is supported by numerical observation rather than an analytic proof (e.g., an explicit tail bound outside [1.5, 3]).

The Lean 4.36.0 formalization certifies only the finite rational/polynomial algebraic identities (e.g., prefix sums and factorizations), leaving all analytic, conformal, and operator-theoretic steps unformalized.
Because the excess Psi_q(A_R) - 2^(1-1/q) decays exponentially as q -> 2^-, optimizing R*(q) in standard float64 introduces precision drift in Table 2 for q >= 1.70.
potential_errors: Page 5 line 27 states the nilpotent disk limit corresponds to R -> infty (via R^-1 A_R -> 2J_2), which is off by a factor of 2: R^-1 A_R = [[R^-1, 1-R^-2], [0, -R^-1]] converges to J_2, whereas 2 R^-1 A_R -> 2J_2.

Table 2 reports R*(1.85) = 101.604233 (with smaller drifts at q=1.70, 1.75, 1.80), whereas 60-digit evaluation and the asymptotic expansion give R*(1.85) ~ 101.593671 (exceeding 4^(1/0.3) ~ 101.593667 by 3.2e-6), due to float64 rounding where excess ~ 2.09e-9.

Page 5 line 2 says Conjugating by I_m oplus V maps X+iY unitarily to oplus_{j=1}^m B, which implicitly uses W(.)W* rather than W*(.)W and suppresses the basis permutation from block 2x2 form to a direct sum of 2x2 blocks.

Page 13 line 4 omits ||p||_{W(A)} in the middle term of the Holder chain (1/n) sum sigma_j^q <= sigma_1^(q-2) * (1/n) sum sigma_j^2 <= (1+sqrt(2))^(q-2) * 5 ||p||_{W(A)}^q, though the final bound is correct.
strong_novelty_candidates: Universal Ky Fan dominance of the Riemann conformal map phi_R on M_2(C) yielding the closed-form Jacobi theta law Psi_q(A_R) = (theta_2(R^-4)/theta_3(R^-4)) * ((R^q+R^-q)/2)^(1/q) (Theorem 3.2).

Exact Hilbert-Schmidt critical phase transition at q_c=2 showing J_2 is uniquely extremal on M_2(C) for q>=2 yet strictly suboptimal for all 1<=q<2, with critical scaling R*(q) ~ 4^(1/(4-2q)) and Psi_1(2) ~ 1.11557524 (Theorem 4.1).

Self-contained n-independent double-layer POVM trace inequality ||p(A)||_{2,norm}^2 <= 4||p||_{W(A)}^2 + (1/n) sum |p(lambda_j)|^2 <= 5||p||_{W(A)}^2 via completing the square in Schur form, bypassing Crouzeix-Palencia recursion and Cauchy-transform bounds (Theorem 5.1).

Universal singular-value weak majorization sigma(A) <_w s^(n) w(A), odd-even parity staircase, Clifford Cl_2 rigidity characterization of even-dimensional extremizers, and centered-disk extension via Berger 2-dilation (Theorem 2.1).
